newsitem.title: USA: Vanco in Gabon ultradeepwater oil deal.
newsitem.headline: Vanco in Gabon ultradeepwater oil deal.

text.p: Vanco Gabon Inc has become the first company to sign a production sharing contract with Gabon for an ultra-deep water block some 90 miles offshore, parent Vanco Energy Co said in a statement.
The triangle-shaped Astrid Marin Block (formerly block K-97) is in water depths ranging between 8,200 and 9,900 feet, the privately-held company said.

The block is the northwest extension of the deep water play now being pursued in the Congo, Cabinda and Angola. The area has yielded Elf Aquitaine's Moho discovery of some 600 million barrels of oil, Chevron's one billion barrels discovery in Cabinda and Elf's Girassol Field which has over 1 billion barrels of oil.
Vanco said has reviewed existing seismic data and plans to shoot 870 miles more within a year and that the first wells will be drilled as soon as a drillship is secured.
Vanco plans to go public in a year and has been doing international offshore work, mostly in the North Sea, since 1972.
Its Gabon deal gives it the largest acreage offshore West Africa of any independent energy company.
